tonight.headline: Tate is newly questionable; Tuten is finally in, and Pickens plays tonight
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. Carnell Tate, your second receiver, was added to Tennessee's injury report today, limited with a back nobody has explained. Barkley has not practised all week.

The good news is that you fixed the lineup: Tuten went into the RB slot at 08:44 and your lineup is now the projection's, 118.8 against 117.5, 51% by ESPN. Pickens plays tonight at 18:15 in your flex with no injury designation; the inactive list was not out when this was written, so glance at it before kickoff. The only thing left this week is Sunday 09:30: if Tate is inactive, Golden.

case.label: Tonight
case.body: Dallas are 8.5-point favourites with a total of 48.5 (Yahoo, 8 Oct 13:31 ET); other books have 8 and 9. Tampa Bay ruled out Baker Mayfield, safety Antoine Winfield Jr., corner Benjamin Morrison and linebacker SirVocea Dennis. They have still allowed the fourth-fewest points to receivers. CeeDee Lamb drew 21 targets last week to Pickens's 3. Your opponent starts the Cowboys' defence tonight.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 15.1 and practising on Thursday, Watson 13.8, Kittle 13.7, the Cowboys' defence 8.4. Tee Higgins is in their flex at 0.0 after missing a second practice, so their 117.5 moves when they replace him; Omarion Hampton, 11.6, is on their bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tate missing Friday's practice, on your side. On theirs, a flex fix is worth about eleven points to them, and you cannot stop it.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · read Friday's report · inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: If Tate is inactive: Golden
doFirst.subtitle: New today. Tate was added to Tennessee's report on Thursday, limited, with a back nobody has explained. Do nothing now; Golden plays at the same hour.

case.label: What happened
case.body: He was not on Wednesday's report. On Thursday the Titans listed him limited with a back injury (titans.com, 15:00; Jim Wyatt, 15:13). Houston's page calls it a knee; five other sources say back. No coach has commented and no report says when it happened.

case.label: How serious
case.body: Unknown. RotoWire's read is that a full practice on Friday would likely keep him off the final report; Heavy expects him to play if the week goes well. Both are outlets' reads, not reporting. A mid-week addition can also be a tweak in practice, and those go either way. ESPN added a questionable tag and left his projection at 13.6.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Golden, 12.7, the lineup check's own answer: Green Bay's lead receiver, not on the injury report, kicking off at 11:00 like Tate, so the swap can wait for the inactive list at 09:30. He faces Chicago, fifth-stingiest to receivers; Tate faces Houston, who allow the most. That is why this is a fallback and not a swap: 0.9 apart, a coin flip that goes to the projection.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate is active and Golden outscores him on Sunday (archive): then the coin flip lost, and no thesis was written on it. If Tate is inactive this card fires.

whatWentWrong.title: Tate turned up on the injury report a day late
whatWentWrong.lead: Limited on Thursday with a back, after a clean Wednesday. He is your second receiver against the defence that gives receivers the most.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: titans.com, 8 Oct 15:00: limited, back; not listed on Wednesday. Houston's copy of the report says knee. No coach quote and no cause in any of the six sources read.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The one card today. He stays in the lineup with Golden named behind him.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice on Friday and no game status takes the card away. A missed practice on Friday makes Golden the likely starter, and the decision is still made at 09:30 on Sunday.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Eight names clear the tool's bar, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. Roman Wilson is new to the list since this morning and is the only one with news behind him today; none of the eight is a move, and you are last in the waiver order.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A three-man rotation by design with Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal: 10 carries and 6 targets in Week 4 (archive). None of the three was on Wednesday's report and Thursday's was not found. Off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — a committee third; the trigger is Hampton missing a game

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson is healthy and on neither Wednesday's nor Thursday's report (Falcons Wire via Yahoo, 8 Oct). 14 carries for 62 last week behind him (archive); the 25.7 was touchdowns.
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns and game script behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: Not on Green Bay's Thursday report; Chris Brooks (ankle) missed again (packers.com, 8 Oct). 7 carries for 13 in Week 4 (archive). Josh Jacobs has no ruling and is out this week (Yahoo, 7 Oct). You dropped Lloyd for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — volume at under two yards a carry in a backfield nobody has won

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty's handcuff: 9 carries for 18 in Week 4 (archive). Jeanty went from a full practice on Wednesday to limited on Thursday with the ankle (Raiders Wire via Yahoo, 8 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — a downgrade for Jeanty, not an absence; nothing unless he misses Friday

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint (archive). Moore did not practise on Thursday, Buffalo's first session; Monday is undetermined (Heavy; Bills On SI, 8 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore sitting on Monday night
rising.sources: Heavy · Bills On SI · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery, as reported on 5 Oct and carried; ESPN lists him out. The tool still prints him because his last game was his biggest.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: Keon Coleman
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 7 targets for 116 after DJ Moore left (archive). The role is exactly as long as Moore's absence, and Moore missed Thursday's practice.
rising.action: WATCH — a role that exists only while Moore is out
rising.sources: Heavy · Bills On SI · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Roman Wilson
rising.roleReason: New to the list. Michael Pittman Jr. re-injured his foot and will miss 'multiple weeks' (McCarthy via Steelers Depot, 8 Oct). Wilson was the second receiver beside DK Metcalf when Pittman sat in Week 2, on 55 of 70 snaps, and drew the same six targets he draws every week (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — a real vacancy and, so far, a flat six targets; he is free, so waiting costs no priority
rising.sources: Steelers Depot · The Fantasy Footballers · Week 1–4 archive
